summary: A trailing campaign says shifting totals mean the race cannot be accurately called and takes it to court.
realLife: After a recount changed the margin more than once, the losing campaign said it was disappointed that the board voted without discussion and said it would sue and, if needed, go to the state supreme court.
sources: The Nevada Independent, commission certifies recount result, December (year not shown on page): https://thenevadaindependent.com/article/clark-county-commission-votes-to-certify-recount-results-15-vote-victory-for-democrat-ross-miller
